subject_group: CATAPULT ASSISTED AND ROCKET ASSISTED TAKE-OFF UA

versions.text: See AMC.283 The limits of the launch safety trace around the launch platform must be determined for each weight, altitude, wind conditions, and temperature within the operational limits established for take-off.
